title.en: Type 311 or M9 when the hose is 25 mm?
title.zh: 软管都是 25 mm 时，选 311 还是 M9？

description.en: Both print 25 mm. Type 311 is fine mortar at 2 m³/h and ≤ 2 mm. M9 is plaster at 30 L/min and ≤ 4 mm.
description.zh: 两台都印 25 mm。311 是 2 m³/h、≤ 2 mm 的细砂浆。M9 是 30 L/min、≤ 4 mm 的石膏。

h1.en: Type 311 or M9 when the hose is 25 mm?
h1.zh: 软管都是 25 mm 时，选 311 还是 M9？

directAnswer.en: Choose by material, not by the shared 25 mm hose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Type 311 for fine mortar: 2 m³/h, ≤ 2 mm, 15 m / 5 m, 4 kW, 220/380 V and 150 kg. M9 is plaster: 30 L/min, ≤ 4 mm, 50 m / 20 m, 50 bar, 380 V/50 Hz, hopper 115 L and 200 kg. A 25 mm hose does not make them interchangeable.
directAnswer.zh: 按材料选，不要按共同的 25 mm 软管选。邢台河北品锦机械把 311 印给细砂浆：2 m³/h、≤ 2 mm、15 m / 5 m、4 kW、220/380V、150 kg。M9 是石膏：30 L/min、≤ 4 mm、50 m / 20 m、50 bar、380V/50Hz、料斗 115 L、200 kg。25 mm 软管不会让它们互换。

heading.en: Vertical reach is 5 m versus 20 m
heading.zh: 垂直距离是 5 m 对 20 m

body.en: Type 311’s vertical cell is 5 m. M9’s is 20 m, with 50 m horizontal. A plaster hose that needs the longer cell is not a reason to stretch Type 311. A mortar particle above 2 mm is not a reason to call it M9, because M9 stops at ≤ 4 mm and is specified as plaster.
body.zh: 311 的垂直格是 5 m。M9 是 20 m，水平 50 m。石膏软管需要更长的那一格，不是把 311 拉长的理由。砂浆粒径超过 2 mm，也不是把它叫成 M9 的理由，因为 M9 停在 ≤ 4 mm，并且按石膏来写。

body.en: Type 311 prints 220/380 V. M9 prints 380 V/50 Hz only. A 220 V site can be discussed on Type 311 if the mortar window fits. It cannot be discussed on M9.
body.zh: 311 印的是 220/380V。M9 只印 380V/50Hz。砂浆窗口对得上时，220V 现场可以在 311 上讨论。不能在 M9 上讨论。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Write plaster or fine mortar, then the voltage. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 先写石膏或细砂浆，再写电压。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.zh: 两台都印了砂灰比 ≤ 1:3 吗？

answer.en: Type 311 does. M9’s published cells are the plaster set: 30 L/min, 50 bar, ≤ 4 mm and the 115 L hopper.
answer.zh: 311 印了。M9 已公布的是石膏那一组：30 L/min、50 bar、≤ 4 mm 和 115 L 料斗。

answer.en: Type 311 prints 150 kg. M9 prints 200 kg.

alt.en: Type 311 mortar sprayer, the 25 mm fine-mortar machine distinct from the M9 plaster sprayer
alt.zh: 311 砂浆喷涂机，25毫米细砂浆机，与 M9 石膏机不同
